definitions.explanation: Speaking ill of someone or damaging their reputation through false or malicious statements.

examples.japanese: {誹謗|ひぼう}{中傷|ちゅうしょう}は{許|ゆる}されない。
examples.english: Slander and defamation are not acceptable.

examples.japanese: ネット{上|じょう}での{誹謗|ひぼう}{中傷|ちゅうしょう}が{社会|しゃかい}{問題|もんだい}になっている。
examples.english: Online slander has become a social problem.

examples.japanese: {有名人|ゆうめいじん}を{誹謗|ひぼう}する{書|か}き{込|こ}みが{増|ふ}えたため、{法的|ほうてき}{措置|そち}が{取|と}られた。
examples.english: Because posts slandering celebrities increased, legal action was taken.

notes:
{誹謗|ひぼう} refers to slandering or speaking ill of someone. It is almost always used in the compound {誹謗|ひぼう}{中傷|ちゅうしょう}, which is the standard legal and media term for defamation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {誹謗|ひぼう}{中傷|ちゅうしょう} (slander and defamation)
- {誹謗|ひぼう}する (to slander)
- {誹謗|ひぼう}{中傷|ちゅうしょう}{対策|たいさく} (anti-defamation measures)

The word has become especially prominent in discussions about cyberbullying and online harassment. Japanese law treats {誹謗|ひぼう}{中傷|ちゅうしょう} as a punishable offense, and recent legal reforms have made it easier to identify anonymous online slanderers.
